newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept S&P 500 futures fall 15-pt initial limit.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept S&P 500 futures fall 15-pt initial limit.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange September Standard and Poor's 500 futures fell their initial daily limit of 15 points in brisk late trade.
September slipped to 912.80 amid sell stops and technical weakness, floor traders said.
September had begun the session strong amid continued expectations for favorable second-quarter corporate earnings, but mild profit taking set in before midday to erode gains.
Traders said a dealer and locals were buyers at limit-down to lift the contract off the day's low.
If September had remained locked limit down for 15 minutes, a two-minute trading halt would have been enacted. After that, a 30-point downside limit would have been in effect.
After 1430 CDT/1930 GMT, the next downside limit would be coordinated with the New York Stock Exchange. There are no upside limits.
